card.title: Don’t Let Reality Notice
card.instruction: Behave as though openly questioning the impossible premise could attract dangerous attention, and respond to doubt with urgent normality.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't call Mum's floating chair impossible. Reality might hear. Pass her the potatoes.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's above the table. I can't reach.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Just a high chair. Fetch the stepladder; dinner's getting cold.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's at the ceiling now. I'm calling for help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Call it room service. Ask for a taller ladder and three desserts upstairs. We're having a perfectly ordinary family dinner.

mechanism: A treats naming the floating chair as dangerous and urgently recasts rescue needs as normal dinner service.
confusable: Unlike simple denial of the bizarre, A's normality performance is explicitly meant to avoid attracting a threatening observer.
comparison: The dinner alternative disguises a help call as room service; the moon alternative limits a personal reply to weather small talk while walking away.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
